project.name: Structured Resume Editor
highlights: Designed a pagination measurement approach and unified rendering state, reducing export rework by 35%.
Merged duplicate inputs and added instant validation, shortening first-draft time by 20%.

basic.name: Jordan Zhou
basic.headline: Frontend Engineer | B2B Products and Design Systems
basic.summary: Four years of B2B experience, focused on complex workspaces, design systems, and reliable software delivery.

highlights: Rebuilt permissions and form infrastructure, reducing the error rate in critical workflows by 31%.
Expanded the design system to six product teams, shortening page delivery by 26%.
Established performance and release budgets, reducing initial page load time by 38% and quarterly defects by 42%.

project.name: Enterprise Design System Upgrade
highlights: Coordinated design and six product teams to upgrade more than 40 pages with zero downtime.

basic.name: Evelyn Zhao
basic.headline: VP, Product & Engineering | Enterprise Software
basic.summary: Enterprise software executive with 15 years of management experience, focused on product portfolios, scaling organizations, and subscription growth.

highlights: Directed a 48-person product, design, and engineering organization; reorganized 14 squads into five outcome portfolios and grew annual recurring revenue by 32%.
Introduced quarterly business planning and service objectives, increasing the on-time release rate from 72% to 91% and reducing severity-one incidents by 44%.
Expanded revenue from CNY 180M to CNY 460M while improving gross margin by 11 percentage points.

project.name: Enterprise Operating Model Transformation
highlights: Reduced duplicate investment by 21% and shortened the decision-making cycle for major cross-functional decisions from six weeks to 12 days.

basic.name: Ruoan Shen
basic.headline: Master's Applicant in Human-Computer Interaction | Explainable AI
basic.summary: Research interests: explainable AI, user trust, and human-AI collaborative decision-making.

highlights: Thesis: How traceable feedback shapes trust in AI-assisted writing
Ranked in the top 8% of the program
Conducted a 24-participant mixed-methods study, coded interviews, and performed preregistered statistical analysis.
Iterated an explainable-feedback prototype, reducing review time by 19%.
